title: Simon 6.3.2(1): integer multiplicity currents are closed under subtraction
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, n ≥ 1, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, and S, T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) integer multiplicity (each represented by some IMRep in U, Simon 6.3.1). Then the difference S − T (the contract's pointwise subtraction) is integer multiplicity.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (S T : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsOpen U → 0 < n → IsIntegerMultiplicity S → IsIntegerMultiplicity T → IsIntegerMultiplicity (S - T)
